title: Canonical maps for etale coordinate trace contractions
statement: For a commutative coefficient ring A and small etale derived categories, use the existing derived tensor, exact inverse image in its left-derived presentation, and ordinary right-derived direct image. Define their notation-free evaluations tensor, pull and push, canonical signed swap, self-product pullback coordinate comparison, proper ordered projection, both proper exchanges, H=f*(-) tensor f*L, evaluation by inverse ordered projection then a specified trace and unitor, comparison by inverse p2 projection and inverse exchange2, directComparison by normalized direct-image compositors and fp1=fp2, coordinateH by tensor pullback comparisons, and shiftedLine(J,d)=J[2d]. These are exactly the maps used in the two conditional contractions; all inverses require the finite-ring proper projection/base-change isomorphism theorems. They are the constructions of [def-kun-derived-tensor], [def-kun-projection-formula-map], [def-kun-unbounded-exchange], [lem-kun-tensor-sym], [lem-kun-tensor-unit], [lem-kun-0f0g] and [lem-kun-proper-base-change-torsion-ring], with derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], scheme/fibre-product notions [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-pc-fibre-product], and the square map of [sbc-def-base-change-map].

def comparison [Finite A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (push A (pullback.snd f f)).obj
      (tensor A (pullback f f) ((pull A (pullback.fst f f)).obj M)
        ((pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj ((pull A f).obj L))) ≅
      (H A f L).obj ((push A f).obj M)
